summary: The study investigates the effect of different deposition techniques and annealing atmospheres on HfO2-based gate stacks. It focuses on the impact of ALD and PVD TiN deposition and annealing in NH3 versus O2 atmospheres on interfacial diffusion and layer composition.
evidence: HfO2 was deposited by ALD using a HfCl4/H2O process at 300 /C176C. The HfO2 layer was also deposited by ALD using HfCl4/H2O starting materials. The post-deposition anneal was carried out in NH3 at 700 /C176C for 60 s.
